name: Skorn Whitecloud
summary: At Bloodhoof Village, aging tauren hunter Skorn Whitecloud guides young hunters and aids travelers facing Mulgore’s dangers.

sections.title: A Guide on the Golden Plains
sections.body: Skorn Whitecloud lives at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, where he guides young hunters in the ways of the hunt. He teaches respect for the plains’ wild creatures. Aspiring hunters prove themselves against cunning flatland prowlers, then take the claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff. Skorn wants those who take up bow or spear to understand the balance between predator and prey.

sections.title: Vigilance Against the Unnatural
sections.body: Skorn Whitecloud watches for strange disturbances across Mulgore’s savannah. Signs of demonic corruption can appear on the wildlife and beasts of the plains. When they do, Skorn helps piece together what happened, keeping the tribes alert to malevolent forces entering their ancestral home.

faq.q: Where can Skorn Whitecloud be found?
faq.answer: Skorn Whitecloud can be found at Bloodhoof Village, the tauren settlement in Mulgore’s southern grasslands.

faq.q: What role does Skorn play for young hunters?
faq.answer: Skorn Whitecloud teaches young hunters the principles of the hunt through The Hunter's Way. He sends them to prove their tracking and combat skills against cunning flatland prowlers, then directs them to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
Skorn Whitecloud offers Skorn's Hammer or Skorn's Rifle to a hunter who brings proof that the great wolf Ghost Howl has fallen. His own hunting days are over.

faq.q: Is Skorn Whitecloud related to any other tauren in Mulgore?
faq.answer: No relatives of Skorn Whitecloud are named in Mulgore. He is known as an old hunter of Bloodhoof Village whose hunting days are behind him.

angles.text: As a young tauren hunter, you can learn from Skorn Whitecloud how to stalk swift predators like the flatland prowler and honor the spiritual harmony of the hunt.
As a tauren, you can see in Skorn the elders’ duty to pass on the honor of the hunt and the practical wisdom of a long life on the plains.
